query:
INSERT INTO github_pull_request_changeset (
                id,
                github_key,
                repository,
                number,
                base_ref,
                base_sha,
                head_ref,
                head_sha,
                files,
                additions,
                deletions,
                patch_blob_key,
                patch_bytes,
                truncated,
                captured_at
            )
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9::jsonb, $10, $11, $12, $13, $14, $15)
            ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
